source: USGS Volcano Hazards Program getElevatedVolcanoes feed (alert level/color code), joined per-request against the Global Volcanism Program (GVP, Smithsonian Institution) WFS geoserver for volcano coordinates (Volcanoes of the World database)
license: USGS side: US government public domain (usgs.gov/information-policies-and-notices/copyrights-and-credits), no key, no rate limit documented. GVP side: the Volcanoes of the World database compilation is US-federal-employee-authored per GVP's own Terms of Use (volcano.si.edu/gvp_termsofuse.cfm, verified live 2026-08-02) — falls under their IP-rights category (2), distinct from the site's general non-commercial narrative/photo Content restriction. Attribution required either way; NOT shipped as an /api/v1 resale mirror (see server/usgsVolcanoes.ts header for the full trace) — /data raw overlay only in this build.
attribution: U.S. Geological Survey · Global Volcanism Program, Smithsonian Institution

field_map.vnum: USGS/GVP shared volcano number — the archive dedup key's first half
field_map.name: volcano name as reported by USGS
field_map.alertLevel: NORMAL | ADVISORY | WATCH | WARNING (USGS's own vocabulary, kept as-reported)
field_map.colorCode: GREEN | YELLOW | ORANGE | RED (USGS's own vocabulary, kept as-reported)
field_map.noticeId: USGS notice_identifier — the archive dedup key's second half; a new value means USGS published a new update for this vnum
field_map.sentUtc: notice-sent timestamp, UTC string as reported
field_map.lat: joined from GVP's WFS; null when the vnum has no GVP coordinate match (rare, kept not dropped)
field_map.lon: joined from GVP's WFS; null when unmatched
field_map.elevationM: joined from GVP's WFS; null when unmatched
field_map.country: joined from GVP's WFS; null when unmatched
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day WE fetched it)

confidence_model: RAW overlay — USGS-reported alert level/color code carried verbatim; coordinates are a LIVE per-request join against GVP (not a static reference table — rescoped 2026-08-01 from an assumed static join), so a coordinate is only as fresh as GVP's own database at fetch time. No predictive claim. Volcanic-degassing-vs-SO2, aviation-ash-risk-vs-aircraft, and nearby-earthquake cross-ties are all open gate-2 hypotheses (open_questions.md), unattempted.
cadence: 30-min poll; USGS elevated-status changes are rare (weekly-to-monthly per volcano in steady state) relative to earthquakes' near-continuous stream
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
